remarks: Beautifully maintained and steps to the Lake. This house is deceiving from the exterior. Entering the home the layout is sprawling, upgrades throughout and bonus features and attention to detail is evident. The tax records do not reflect the addition of a bedroom and full bathroom (used to be an attached garage). This home is currently used as an Airbnb (sleeps 8 comfortably) and rental history can be provided. It is beautifully decorated and maintained. Bonus features of the house include; additional space in basement for rec area, or shop, gas fireplace in living room to enjoy during cool nights and winter, large deck for entertaining accessed through dining room, butchers block kitchen counter, sun room off the kitchen, large private yard and fire pit area to host many activities in the summer.  Private access to the beach is across the street for foot traffic and jet skis.
